evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce CLASHarness (Conflict-Loaded Agent Scenario Harness), a controllable framework for generating verifiable multi-agent conflicts in computer use, with a benchmark of 600 multi-round tasks.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems to automate complex computer-use workflows, yet existing benchmarks mostly assume consistent, cooperative environments.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: By combining hierarchical scenario planning with an eight-step verified micro-pipeline, CLASHarness pre-commits decisive visual facts before rendering and compiles hybrid code and semantic graders directly from executed reference trajectories, guaranteeing every task is solvable by construction.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Evaluating 15 frontier models on CLASHarness reveals three core bottlenecks.
